verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only generic marketing language ('Ryzen AI Software For Developers' link, 'gateway to breakthrough AI experiences') but no NPU is documented on this desktop 9950X3D part, and no TOPS figure or precision is stated anywhere in the pack. Desktop Ryzen 9000X3D chips lack an integrated NPU (unlike mobile Ryzen AI chips), and none of the evidence contradicts this by showing an actual NPU/runtime shipping for this SKU.
